annotations.title: Get the Buy Now link for a FICKEL product

description: Get the steps to buy a product. For most products that are not apparel or headwear this returns buy_url, the exact fickelusa.com product page (the same link as the FICKELUSA.COM label in the FICKEL app). The buyer completes the purchase on that page. FICKEL does not take payment. If the product is apparel, headwear, or screen printed, buy_url is omitted and the steps point to request_quote so the artwork can be reviewed (most items start around 100 pieces).
